question: During absolute refractory, do same-time positive arrivals cancel inhibitory current before the production clamp, and can that accounting choice change one fixed post-refractory spike observable relative to a positive-ignore shadow comparator?

supported_contract_scope.bound_source_comment: Inhibition can still shorten the post-spike residual; positive drive is ignored during the absolute refractory window.
supported_contract_scope.theory_spec_scope: The bound theory spec defines signed arrival-time accumulation and says a unit emits only when it is not refractory, but it does not explicitly specify mixed-sign current accounting inside the refractory window.
supported_contract_scope.test_scope: The bound field tests cover delayed propagation, coincident subthreshold arrivals, and checkpoint continuation, but do not establish mixed-sign refractory accounting semantics.
supported_contract_scope.interpretation_rule: Production code behavior alone is not promoted to an explicit supported refractory-current contract statement.

machine_fact_binding.comment_fact: Bound source contains the exact positive-drive-ignored refractory comment.
machine_fact_binding.decision_relevant_extractor_policy: Any structural/source/hash mismatch is INVALID_DIAGNOSTIC; do not repair or relabel after outcome visibility.

input_family.matched_rule: Production and shadow receive identical unit state, field config, current magnitudes, timestamps, treatment-arm labels, and probe. The only comparator difference is refractory mixed-sign accounting: production nets all same-time signed current before clamp; shadow discards positive current during refractory then applies inhibition. Outside refractory both use identical net-current semantics.

comparator.shadow_scope: Read-only harness comparator only; production source is never mutated.

decision_rules.supported_mixed_sign_runtime_condition: True iff exact bound production structurally groups same-time signed SynapticArrival currents and permits both positive and negative current values through the public scheduling path.
decision_rules.outside_control_must_match: For every arm outside refractory, production and shadow must match potential_after_treatment and post_refractory_probe_spike_count within the fixed tolerance; otherwise INVALID_DIAGNOSTIC.
decision_rules.state_effect: Within refractory balanced_same_time, state_effect is true iff production and shadow potential_after_treatment differ by more than 1e-12.
decision_rules.functional_effect: Within refractory balanced_same_time, functional_effect is true iff post_refractory_probe_spike_count differs between production and shadow. No post-outcome threshold or probe change is permitted.
decision_rules.core_control_validity: Inhibition-only and excitation-only arms must execute successfully in both production and shadow; treatment spikes must be zero in all refractory arms.

terminal_mapping.INVALID_DIAGNOSTIC: Any source/blob/head/contract/machine-fact mismatch, matched-input violation, outside-refractory control mismatch, core-control failure, forbidden input access, or inability to execute the fixed comparator/observable exactly as bound.
terminal_mapping.EXPLICIT_NETTING_CONTRACT_MATCHES_PRODUC: A bound supported canonical doc/test statement explicitly defines mixed-sign refractory accounting as net-current-before-clamp and production structurally matches it.
terminal_mapping.NO_SUPPORTED_MIXED_SIGN_RUNTIME_CONDITIO: The bound supported public field/event contracts cannot represent same-time mixed-sign current without changing semantics or using forbidden surfaces.
terminal_mapping.FUNCTIONAL_REFRACTORY_ACCOUNTING_EFFECT: The balanced refractory arm has a production-vs-shadow state difference and the single fixed post-refractory probe spike count differs.
terminal_mapping.STATE_ONLY_REFRACTORY_ACCOUNTING_EFFECT: The balanced refractory arm has a production-vs-shadow state difference but the fixed post-refractory probe spike count is identical.
terminal_mapping.NO_SEMANTIC_DIFFERENCE_UNDER_FIXED_PROBE: The supported balanced refractory arm executes validly but production and shadow have no state or functional difference under the fixed treatment/probe.
terminal_mapping.MIXED_OR_AMBIGUOUS_REFRACTORY_CONTRACT: The valid bounded result does not satisfy any more specific terminal class without adding a new semantic choice.

forbidden_inputs: SUB exploratory artifact as Architecture evidence
stop_condition: Any valid terminal Architecture classification stops cycle 1 for fresh Evidence Analyst review. No same-run implementation change, cycle 2, PRE_FORMAL, or FORMAL continuation. Any outcome-bearing failure requiring redesign is INVALID_DIAGNOSTIC and stops.
